fill_default_args: fill default arguments into a kwargs dict by inspecting a function's signature and parameter defaults
freeze_all_params: freeze all parameters in a list of PyTorch modules by setting requires_grad to False
is_symmetrized: check if two ground truth dicts contain symmetrized instance pairs by comparing their instance lists
flip_tensor: flip a tensor so that even and odd indexed elements are swapped using torch stack and flatten
interleave_tensors: interleave two tensors by stacking them alternately and returning both interleaving orderings
